## 8. API Integration

### 8.1 API Service Architecture

**Contract:** `src/api/schema.d.ts` is generated by `openapi-typescript` from
`../electric-wealth-api-spring/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1.0, "Electric Wealth API" 0.1.0). `npm run check:api` fails
when the file is stale; it passed against API commit `8a61cde` on 2026-10-16.

**Client** ([client.ts](../../src/api/client.ts)):

```ts
export const api = createClient<paths>({ baseUrl: window.location.origin });
api.use(headersMiddleware);
```

| Piece | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `window.location.origin` — every call is same-origin `/api/...`; the dev server proxies it to `API_URL` |
| `headersMiddleware.onRequest` | Sets `Authorization: Bearer <tokenStore.accessToken>` unless the request already has one; always sets `Accept-Language` to `en-CA` or `fr-CA` |
| `headersMiddleware.onResponse` | On `401` for any path **not** starting with `/api/auth/`, dispatches `window` event `ew:unauthorized` |
| `unwrap(result)` | Returns `result.data`, or throws `ApiError(status, error.code ?? 'UNKNOWN', error.message ?? statusText, error.traceId)` from the `ErrorEnvelope` |
| `ApiError` | `Error` subclass with `status`, `code`, `traceId?` |
| `Schemas` | Alias for `components['schemas']`, used for request/response types in hooks and pages |

**Conventions:** money is integer minor units (cents); the UI converts with `formatMoney(minor / 100)` and the goal
form converts dollars to cents with `Math.round(Number(dollars) * 100)`. Dates are ISO strings. Percentages are
numbers where `0.65` means 0.65 %.

**Query layer:** [hooks.ts](../../src/api/hooks.ts) wraps each call in `useQuery` / `useMutation`
(see [06.2](06-state-management.md#62-state-slices--modules)). Exceptions that call `api` directly: auth
(`AuthContext.tsx`), registration (`RegisterPage.tsx`) and document download (`DocumentsPage.tsx`).

### 8.2 API Endpoints Consumed

47 of the 49 operations in `openapi.json`. Not used: `GET /health`, `GET /api/market/quote`.

| # | Method & path | Caller | Request details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `POST /api/auth/token` | `AuthContext.login` | `{ grantType: 'password', username, password }` |
| 2 | `POST /api/auth/mfa/verify` | `AuthContext.verifyMfa` | `{ challengeId: 'web', code, method: 'sms' }` (fixed values; the API ignores both) |
| 3 | `POST /api/auth/refresh` | `AuthContext` interval (10 min) | `{ refreshToken }` |
| 4 | `POST /api/auth/logout` | `AuthContext.logout` | `{ refreshToken }` + explicit `Authorization` header; fire-and-forget |
| 5 | `POST /api/registration/start` | `RegisterPage` step 1 | `{ email, password }` → `registrationId` |
| 6 | `POST /api/registration/verify-identity` | step 2 | `{ registrationId, accountNumber, postalCode, dateOfBirth }` → `name` |
| 7 | `GET /api/registration/security-questions` | step 3 (query enabled only on step 3) | — |
| 8 | `POST /api/registration/security-questions` | step 3 | `{ registrationId, answers: [{questionId, answer}] × 2 }` |
| 9 | `POST /api/registration/trusted-contact` | step 5 (skippable) | `{ registrationId, name, relationship, phone?, email? }` |
| 10 | `POST /api/registration/complete` | step 6 | `{ registrationId, mfaMethod, consents: { terms, privacy, electronicDelivery: true } }` → tokens |
| 11 | `GET /api/wealth/dashboard` | `useDashboard` | — |
| 12 | `GET /api/profile` | `useProfile` | — |

| 14 | `GET /api/preferences` | `usePreferences` | — |
| 15 | `PUT /api/preferences` | `useUpdatePreferences` | partial `PreferencesUpdate` (`theme`, `language`, `notifications.{email,sms,push}`, `documentDelivery`, `defaultMeetingType`) |

| 27 | `GET /api/notifications` | `useNotifications` | polled every 60 s |
| 28 | `POST /api/notifications/{id}/read` | `useMarkNotificationRead` | — |
| 29 | `POST /api/notifications/read-all` | `useMarkAllNotificationsRead` | — |
| 30 | `GET /api/education/content` | `useEducationContent` | `level?` (`beginner` / `intermediate` / `advanced`) |

| 32 | `GET /api/education/glossary` | `useGlossary` | `q?` (omitted when empty) |

Endpoint behaviour, status codes and response shapes are documented in the API's consumer guide:
`<KB>/source-docs/electric-wealth-api-spring/api-consumer/04-endpoint-catalog.md`.

### 8.3 Error Handling

| Situation | Handling |
|---|---|
| Any non-2xx | `unwrap()` throws `ApiError` with the envelope's `code`, `message`, `traceId` |
| Query failure | TanStack Query retries once for network errors and `status >= 500`, never for 4xx; the page shows `<ErrorState>` (generic text, trace id, Retry) |
| `401` on a protected call | Middleware fires `ew:unauthorized` → `logout('expired')` → login screen with "session expired" notice |
| `401` on `/api/auth/*` | Not broadcast; the caller decides (wrong password → `auth.invalid_credentials`; wrong MFA code → `auth.mfa_invalid`; MFA `UNAUTHORIZED` code → `logout('expired')`) |
| `404` account | `AccountDetailPage` shows the not-found `EmptyState` |
| Known business codes | Mapped to specific messages: `VALIDATION_ERROR` (goal, address), `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE` (booking), registration codes `EMAIL_TAKEN`, `IDENTITY_MISMATCH`, `ALREADY_ENROLLED`, `REGISTRATION_NOT_FOUND` (also resets the wizard to step 1), `STEP_OUT_OF_ORDER`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `429 RATE_LIMITED` | No special handling: treated as a 4xx (no retry), generic error |
| Token refresh fails | `logout('expired')` |
| Logout call fails | Ignored (`.catch(() => undefined)`); local sign-out happens anyway |
| Document download fails | No user-facing error: `download()` has `try/finally` without `catch`, so the rejection is unhandled and the button simply re-enables |

Details in [10](10-error-handling-and-logging.md).
